---

Merged story (29 Sep 2026): absorbs SCRUM-54 (Notify Coordinator of Booking Outcome). Any reference to SCRUM-54 elsewhere now means this story.

User Story
As an Event Coordinator, I want to view the status of my submitted booking requests, so that I can track progress and plan accordingly.

Acceptance Criteria

* Coordinator can view a list of their requests with current status.
* Selecting a request shows full submitted details and, if applicable, Venue Staff's response.

---

Merged from SCRUM-54 — Notify Coordinator of Booking Outcome

As an Event Coordinator, I want to be notified when my booking request is approved or rejected (with reason), so that I can continue planning without delay.

Acceptance Criteria:

* Coordinator is notified when status changes.
* Rejection notification includes the reason provided by Venue Staff.

Note: confirmed 2026-09-06 as the sole owner of the venue-booking-decision notification — a duplicate bullet in "User is notified on coordinator assignment" (SCRUM-46) was removed to avoid two stories independently delivering the same notification.
